verdicts.title: A Lower Bound for the Fourier Entropy of Boolean Functions on the Biased Hypercube
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study Boolean functions on the $p$-biased hypercube $(\{0,1\}^n,μ_p^n)$ through the lens of Fourier (spectral) entropy, i.e. the Shannon entropy of the squared $p$-biased Fourier coefficients. Motivated by recent restriction-based advances on upper bounds toward the Fourier-Entropy-Influence (FEI) conjecture, we prove a complementary, sharp lower bound that decomposes the entropy into coordinate-wise contributions.
